notes:
Snapshot: large heritage media archive (news transcripts, video captions, legal metadata). Primary ask: semantic search + reranking across massive index (targeting 200M–1B+ vectors in phase 1).

Key pain: current search infra (homegrown + Elasticsearch + Faiss) costly at 100M vectors, poor tail latency on rerank, no consistent cost model. COO: "We need predictable unit costs per query and sub-100ms tail for user-facing search."

Tech requirements (shorthand):
- Ingest pipeline: 50–200 TB text equivalents/year, chunking 150–400 tokens, metadata-heavy (timecode, program id).
- Scale target: initial 200M vectors -> planned to 1B within 18 months.
- QPS/Latency: baseline 500 QPS peak; target p95 latency for retrieval+rerank <120ms, ideal <80ms for top-10 UX.
- Reranking: cross-encoder style reranker for top-100 candidates; want model routing to smaller cross-encoder for cost control.
- Embedding model: open embeddings preferred; will validate OpenAI/GPT-compatible later. Want ability to pin model version and run canary.
- Cost constraints: aggressive unit-cost optimization; price sensitivity driven by high query volume. Looking for batching + KV/prefix caching to reduce token cost.
- HW/ops: prefer Dedicated or Private (on-prem racks) to keep data in-country; need HSM/KMS for keys and audit logs for compliance.

POC scope (current eval):
- Ingest 200M vectors subset (10–30M at a time for pipeline tests).
- Run retrieval at simulated peak 500 QPS with caching on prefix + batch retrieval.
- Evaluate end-to-end cost per query with and without rerank.
- Measure cross-encoder latency baseline on dedicated GPU vs quantized variants.

- Ingest: suggest sharded vector stores with time-sliced compaction; evaluate multi-index approach (hot index for recent 30 days, cold index for archive).
- Routing: propose smart routing by region + model tier (cheap embed-only retrieval vs expensive rerank fallback).
- Batching/caching: recommend aggressive batching for embedding ingest and prefix KV caching for conversational flows.
- Quantization: test 8-bit and 4-bit quantized reranker models to measure latency/cost tradeoffs.
